small_graph.generator_control: Apply modern and paper-era generators to the identical new base graph.

fixed_controls.inputs: Exact archived paper graph and successful guardfix packed/place files; every attempt has private byte-identical copies.
fixed_controls.ideal_clock_scope: Explicit diagnostic for BRAM Fc=0; shared graph kept byte-identical.
fixed_controls.interpretation: Tool-version control conditional on legacy graph/input compatibility. Not native A0, not H3D, and not a modern end-to-end benchmark.

limits: Pilot selection of three previously successful cases; no circuit-population inference.
No runtime speedup claim from concurrent runs.
Modern 100x100x2 end-to-end PnR, full OpenFPGA and bitstream flow remain outside this pilot.
